scope: Production dependency installation only; not application import, runtime, IPC, revocation or deploy acceptance
sourceInputs: Exact package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml from spikes/infra-mcp-source-snapshot; hashes are pinned in expected-inventory.json
independentIntegrityProof: 92 public registry tarballs were downloaded without authentication, SHA512 SRI matched the unchanged lock and own pnpm store index, and every regular archive member was compared byte-for-byte to the installed files in both directories. No installed module was imported.
normalization: Only the owned per-installation root was replaced for the two pnpm-generated bin wrappers. Published file digests and package versions/integrities were not normalized.
limits: Registry selection, input audit and a clean process environment are not an OS-enforced network sandbox.
The two generated bin wrappers are installer output, not published tarball members; compare them between paired runs, not as package tarball files.
The committed expected-inventory.json is a frozen integrity reference derived from the audited tarballs. It must not be regenerated automatically to accept a mismatch.
No compiler, application entrypoint, service, listener, IPC/systemd validation or deployment was executed. Paused operations remain paused.
